description: This file contains functions related to handling ACS connections, subscriptions, and notifications within a TR-069 management context. It manages subscription addition, removal, updates, and notification handling, as well as initialization and cleanup of ACS connection resources.

methods.name: void set_subscription_new_value(const char * path,const char * value)
methods.description: Sets a new subscription value based on a parameter path and value string, interacting with the underlying ACS environment.

methods.name: void DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionHandleNotification(const char * path,const amxc_var_t * const data)
methods.description: Handles notification messages received from the ACS, processes parameter changes, updates subscriptions, and schedules inform messages.

methods.name: char * DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionHandleGetwandevice(dm_amx_env_t * amx,const char * ipaddress,char ** addressFound)
methods.description: Placeholder function (returns NULL), intended to get the WAN device path based on IP address.

methods.name: bool DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionHandleGetwaninterface(UNUSED dm_amx_env_t * amx,const char * ipaddress,char ** ppWanInterface)
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the WAN interface path for a given IP address, handling IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: bool DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionInitialize(dm_amx_env_t * amx,const char * backend,const char * uri)
methods.description: Initializes the ACS connection, creating the context and setting up subscription list.

methods.name: void DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionCleanup(dm_amx_env_t * amx)
methods.description: Cleans up the ACS connection, deleting subscriptions and freeing resources.

methods.name: amxc_var_t * find_subscription_by_path(const char * path)
methods.description: Finds a subscription in the system data model by parameter path.

methods.name: amxc_var_t * get_subscription_value(const char * path)
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a subscription given its path.

methods.name: void add_subscription_to_dm(const char * path,DM_ENG_NotificationMode mode)
methods.description: Adds a new subscription to the data model with specified path and notification mode.

methods.name: void remove_subscription_from_dm(const char * subscriptionPath)
methods.description: Removes a subscription from the data model based on its path.

methods.name: bool update_subscription_in_dm(const char * subscriptionPath,const char * notification_mode,DM_ENG_NotificationMode mode)
methods.description: Updates the notification mode of an existing subscription in the data model.

methods.name: bool DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionAddSubscription(dm_amx_env_t * amx,const char * subscriptionPath,int * subscriptionID,DM_ENG_NotificationMode mode)
methods.description: Adds a parameter subscription, interacts with the data model and management server to create or update subscriptions.

methods.name: bool DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionRemoveSubscription(dm_amx_env_t * amx,const char * subscriptionPath,int subscriptionID)
methods.description: Removes a parameter subscription from the data model and internal list.

methods.name: int DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionGetSubscriptions(dm_amx_env_t * amx,DM_ENG_SubscriptionStruct ** pResult)
methods.description: Retrieves all current subscriptions from the data model into a list of subscription structures.
